topics.title: AI model capabilities and tool augmentation

claims.text: AI systems are not inherently intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits and ready-made solutions rather than innate understanding.
Toolkits can provide large performance gains but cannot fully compensate for the lack of basic model capabilities.
Older models were trained on massive data without clear purpose, while modern models aim to maximise performance from fewer parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.

The cover is considered rarely used, only seen a few times (receiving the diploma, photographing it, later translating documents).

topics.title: Fitting multiple GPUs into a small PC case

claims.text: A small PC case officially fits only one small GPU, but with straps and force it can accommodate three GPUs.
